description: This file defines a CLI command class for processing emails within a PHP project using Symfony Console components. It configures the command, binds dependencies via constructor injection, and executes a queue processing job for email tasks.

classes.name: EmailProcessorCommand
classes.description: A command class for processing pending emails, integrating queue and email task processors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the command with dependencies for queue processing and email task processing.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's name and description.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the email processing queue and returns the status code.
